botPage.pageTitle: Kitoblarim bot — finish the books you start
botPage.pageDescription: Books left half-read? Kitoblarim is a free Telegram bot that splits a book into a few pages a day, reminds you daily and picks your next book.
botPage.heroHeadline:
You start a book.
It stops halfway.
botPage.heroSubline: Kitoblarim is a free Telegram bot. It splits a book into a few pages a day, reminds you every day and takes you to the last page.

mock.label: A sample daily reminder from the bot
mock.author: Pirimqul Qodirov
mock.message: Today's goal: 12 pages of “Starry Nights”. 358 pages to go.

botPage.painsLead: Most books are dropped not because they're bad, but because there's no daily habit. Kitoblarim builds exactly that habit.

pains.fix: The bot splits it into a daily goal: 300 pages in 20 days is 15 pages a day. A big book becomes small steps.
Log what you read with one button, right in the chat. The bot remembers the page and shows what's left.

pains.pain: “I'll read tomorrow,” and tomorrow there's no time either.
pains.fix: The bot reminds you at the time you choose. It stays quiet on days you read, and if you fall behind, the goal is spread over the days left.

pains.pain: You don't know what to read next.
pains.fix: The bot suggests three books based on your shelf and ratings.
Run a reading marathon in your Telegram group, or share one shelf with your family.

pains.pain: You can't recall how much you've read.
pains.fix: Every finished book on one shelf, by year, and at the end of each month a list ready to share.

steps.title: Open the bot
steps.body: @kitob_javonim_bot in Telegram. No sign-up, no password.

steps.title: Pick a book and a deadline
steps.body: Type its title, scan its barcode, or jump in from a book's page in this catalogue with one tap. You choose how many days.

steps.title: A few pages a day
steps.body: The bot tells you the daily goal and reminds you. You read and log it with one button.

botPage.example: For example, “Oʻtkan kunlar” (Bygone Days) has 384 pages. Finish it in 30 days, and the bot plans 13 pages a day.

features.title: Month in review

botPage.catalogueTitle: From the catalogue to the bot in one tap
botPage.catalogueBody: Every book page on kitoblarim.uz has a “Make a reading plan in Telegram” button. The bot finds the book itself and only asks how many days you want. A review you write in the bot appears here, on the book's page, once an editor approves it.

faq.a: Kitoblarim is a free bot and mini app inside Telegram. It helps you finish the book you started: it splits the book into a daily goal, reminds you every day and keeps what you've read on one shelf. In Telegram: @kitob_javonim_bot.
Yes. No sign-up and no card details: your Telegram account is enough.

faq.q: Can I get a book's PDF in the bot?
faq.a: No. Kitoblarim doesn't hand out book files. You can buy the book in a shop or read it free in a library: each book's page shows where it's sold, for how much, and which libraries have it. Audiobooks shared with permission can be played in the bot.

A reminder comes at the time you choose, and only if you haven't read yet that day. If you ignore three in a row, the bot stops reminding you until you come back. You can also turn them off in Settings.

faq.q: Do I need to download anything?
faq.a: No. Everything runs inside Telegram, on your phone and on your computer.

faq.q: What if my book isn't in the bot?
faq.a: Enter its title and page count yourself, or scan its barcode. Once a moderator checks it, the book joins the catalogue for other readers too.

faq.q: Can we run a reading marathon in a group?
faq.a: Yes. Add the bot to the group, and an admin picks a length (7, 14 or 30 days) and a daily goal with /marafon. The bot posts every day, members check in with one button, and a ranking comes out every week. The bot doesn't read the group's messages.

botPage.finalBody: Free, right in Telegram, in a minute.
